verdict.headline: NOT YET - no statistically clear edge; the fix behaves like an ordinary price level so far.
details: At the fix level price bounced 37% of the time (415 touches) vs 42% at placebo levels (-5 pts, p=0.0579).
Magnet beta: fix 0.0126 (t=1.16) vs placebo 0.0075 (t=0.83). Negative = price pulled back toward the level.
